title: IFTTT alternatives for phones, homes and work | 50agents
description: IFTTT alternatives: Apple Shortcuts on your iPhone, Home Assistant for a local smart home, Zapier or Make for work apps, and 50agents for email chores.
answer: For your phone, Apple Shortcuts; for a local smart home, Home Assistant.
For work apps, Zapier or Make. For email chores like drafting replies, 50agents builds an AI agent from one sentence.

faqs.q: Is there a free alternative to IFTTT?
faqs.a: Make has a free plan with 1,000 credits a month, and 50agents is free to start. Home Assistant is open source and runs on your own device.

faqs.q: Which IFTTT alternative suits a smart home?
faqs.a: Home Assistant. It is open source, keeps your data local and lists 1600+ integrations.
IFTTT Free has 1,000 credits a month with hourly checks. Starter is $2.09 a month, billed $25.08 a year.

faqs.q: What does IFTTT's free plan include?
faqs.a: Free has 1,000 credits a month and unlimited Applets, and checks for new events every hour.
Apple Shortcuts runs on your iPhone or iPad and starts from the time of day, arriving somewhere or opening an app. IFTTT has phone apps for iOS and Android.

faqs.q: How many apps do the alternatives connect?
faqs.a: IFTTT lists 1,000+ services. Home Assistant lists 1600+ integrations, Make 3,500+ apps and Zapier 10,541+. 50agents works with 2,300+ apps through viaSocket.

faqs.q: Do I need my own hardware for Home Assistant?
faqs.a: Yes. You run it yourself on a device at home, so setup and updates are yours.
